# pangolin_idp_oidc (Resource)

A global OIDC identity provider users can sign in with. Needs a root API key, and isn't available when the server runs with `IDENTITY_PROVIDER_MODE=org`. Import using the IdP ID, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_idp_oidc.example 4`. With session_revalidation on, an imported IdP's scopes include `offline_access`; leave it in `scopes` or expect one in-place update that settles the difference.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_idp_oidc" "example" {
  name            = "Company SSO"
  client_id       = var.oidc_client_id
  client_secret   = var.oidc_client_secret
  auth_url        = "https://login.example.com/oauth2/authorize"
  token_url       = "https://login.example.com/oauth2/token"
  scopes          = "openid profile email"
  identifier_path = "sub"
  email_path      = "email"
  name_path       = "name"

  # Sign users out once the identity provider stops accepting their session
  # (Pangolin 1.26+, Enterprise).
  session_revalidation = true

  auto_provision       = true
  default_role_mapping = "'Member'"
}

# Register this as the callback URL with the identity provider.
output "oidc_redirect_url" {
  value = pangolin_idp_oidc.example.redirect_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_url` (String) Authorization endpoint URL.
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret.
- `identifier_path` (String) JMESPath to the user's unique identifier in the ID token, e.g. `sub`.
- `name` (String) Display name shown on the login page.
- `scopes` (String) Space-separated scopes to request, e.g. `openid profile email`. With session_revalidation on, Pangolin adds `offline_access` itself (or, for Google, removes it), so there is no need to list it.
- `token_url` (String) Token endpoint URL.

### Optional

- `auto_provision` (Boolean) Create users and assign their orgs and roles automatically on first sign-in. Defaults to false.
- `default_org_mapping` (String) JMESPath expression that picks the orgs for auto-provisioned users. Pangolin starts it as `'{{orgId}}'`.
- `default_role_mapping` (String) JMESPath expression that picks the role for auto-provisioned users. Pangolin starts it as `'Member'`.
- `email_path` (String) JMESPath to the user's email in the ID token.
- `name_path` (String) JMESPath to the user's display name in the ID token.
- `session_revalidation` (Boolean) Keep checking a signed-in user's session with the identity provider using refresh tokens, and end it once the provider no longer accepts it. Requires Pangolin 1.26 or later with an Enterprise license. Defaults to false.
- `tags` (String) Free-form tags.
- `variant` (String) Provider flavour: oidc, google or azure. Defaults to oidc.

### Read-Only

- `idp_id` (Number) Pangolin-assigned IdP ID.
- `redirect_url` (String) Callback URL to register with the identity provider. Only known for IdPs created by Terraform, not imported ones.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_idp_oidc.example 4
```
